actions.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
Introduced in the Senate, read twice, considered, read the third time, and passed without amendment by Unanimous Consent. (consideration: CR S8755-8757; text: CR S8755-8756)
Passed/agreed to in Senate: Introduced in the Senate, read twice, considered, read the third time, and passed without amendment by Unanimous Consent.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts residents, visitors, and local entities in Fulton, Missouri, and Oswego, New York, alongside federal park administrators.
dimensions.evidence: establish the Fort Ontario Holocaust Refugee Shelter National Historical Park, to designate the America's National Churchill Museum National Historic Landmark

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a park unit and landmark designation with provisions for cooperative agreements and studies, maintaining existing property owner rights.
dimensions.evidence: Designation of the America's National Churchill Museum as a National Historic Landmark shall not prohibit any actions that may otherwise be taken by a property owner

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes land acquisition through donation, purchase, or exchange, and requires a resource study, but specifies no aggregate dollar appropriation.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may acquire land and interests in land located within the boundary of the National Historical Park by donation, purchase with donated or appropriated funds, or exchange.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a new National Park System unit, designates a national historic landmark, and mandates a federal special resource study.
dimensions.evidence: there is established in the State as a unit of the National Park System the Fort Ontario Holocaust Refugee Shelter National Historical Park.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent national historical park unit and landmark designation.

missing_information: Exact acreage of the proposed national historical park.
Total cost estimates for federal land acquisition and park development.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a new national historical park in New York, designates a national historic landmark in Missouri, authorizes cooperative agreements, and mandates a special resource study.
